# Evidence ledger (exploratory re-analysis and planning simulation)

**Post hoc, exploratory (not pre-specified).** Every number in `paper/generated/exploratory/*.tex`, with the file and JSON path it is read from. Generated by `python scripts/exploratory_reanalysis.py`; nothing is entered by hand. The pre-specified pilot results and their ledger are `results/runs/pilot-v0.3.3/analysis.json` and `paper/evidence_ledger.md`.
